**How to update your address in Aadhaar online (official UIDAI process)**  

| # | Action | What to do (short) |
|---|--------|--------------------|
| 1 | **Log‑in to the MyAadhaar portal** | Open https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/ and sign in with your Aadhaar number, OTP (sent to your registered mobile) and password/PIN. |
| 2 | **Select “Update Demographics Data & Check Status”** | From the dashboard click the *Update Demographics* / *Update Address* option. |
| 3 | **Choose “Address” as the field to edit** | Pick *Address* (or *Document Update* → *Address*) and click **Proceed**. |
| 4 | **Enter the new address in English** (the portal will transliterate it to the chosen regional language)【1†L33-L42】. |
| 5 | **Upload a valid Proof‑of‑Address (POA) document** (scan or coloured photo in PDF/JPEG) – the document must be on the UIDAI‑approved list and in your name【1†L57-L64】. |
| 6 | **Pay the online fee (₹ 50 incl. GST)** – the fee is required for every address‑update request【3†L63-L66】. |
| 7 | **Submit the request** | After payment you receive a downloadable invoice that contains a Service Request Number (SRN). The SRN is also sent by SMS to your registered mobile【1†L47-L49】. |
| 8 | **Track the status** | Use the SRN on the *Check Aadhaar Update Status* page (https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/CheckAadhaarStatus) to see whether the update is processed【1†L44-L50】. |

**Key points from the official UIDAI sources**

* The online address‑update service is available only if your mobile number is already linked to Aadhaar【1†L23-L27】.  
* You can update the address only (other details like name, DOB, gender require a physical centre)【3†L70-L73】.  
* The request is considered “served” once the invoice with SRN is generated; no refund is given after that【3†L26-L31】.  

Follow the above eight steps on the **MyAadhaar** portal to change your address quickly and securely.

L461: \## Frequently asked questions
L462: \[### Online Address Update Process
L463: \](javascript:void(0);)
L464: \[
L465: \#### My online address update request got rejected for invalid documents. What
L466: does this mean?
L467: Open or Close
L468: \](javascript:void(0))
L469: Aadhaar update requests to be supported by valid/proof of address (POA) document.
L470: A request can be rejected for invalid document in following scenarios:
L471: 1\. The Proof of Address(POA) document should be a Valid document, as per
L472: document list available at \[List of Supporting
L473: Document\](https://uidai.gov.in/images/commdoc/List\_of\_Supporting\_Document\_for\_Aadhaar\_Enrolment\_and\_Update.pdf)
L474: 2\. Document is in the name of the Aadhaar holder for whom update request is
L475: submitted.
L476: 3\. Address details entered should match the address with the address mentioned
L477: in the document.
L478: 4\. Image uploaded should be clear and colored scan of original document.
L479: \[
L480: \#### I successfully submitted my address update request. How can I track this?
L481: Open or Close
L482: \](javascript:void(0))
L483: On successful submission of an online address update request, a SRN (Service
L484: Request Number) is generated, which is shown on screen and also sent via SMS to
L485: your registered mobile number. After successful submission of the request, please
L486: download the invoice containing the SRN number and other details. The status of
L487: the update request can be checked at the bottom of the page by login in to
L488: \[Check Aadhaar Update
L489: Status\](https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/CheckAadhaarStatus.)
L490: \[
L491: \#### Can I update my address in my local language through online portal?
L492: Open or Close
L493: \](javascript:void(0))
L494: You have to enter the details in English, which shall be transliterated into your
L495: selected regional language. You can update for any correction in transliteration
L496: if required. The following regional languages are available for update of address
L497: through online.
L498: Bengali, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Odia, Punjabi, Tamil,
L499: Telugu and Urdu.
L500: \[
L501: \#### Where can I Update my Mobile Number?
L502: Open or Close
L503: \](javascript:void(0))

L505: can locate the centre at \[Bhuvan Aadhaar

L510: Open or Close
L511: \](javascript:void(0))
L512: Yes, mobile number should be registered to Aadhaar for using online services.
